SELECT eis.system_id AS systemId, eis.name, eis.code, eis.version, eis.desc AS description, eis.biz_create_time AS bizCreateTime, eis.biz_update_time AS bizUpdateTime,
sot.name AS objectTypeName, ss.name AS statusName, creator.user_name AS createByName
FROM eval_index_system eis
LEFT JOIN sys_object_type sot ON eis.object_type_id = sot.type_id LEFT JOIN sys_status ss ON eis.status_id = ss.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON eis.create_by = creator.user_id
WHERE eis.system_id = #{systemId} AND eis.deleted = 0
SELECT eic.category_id AS categoryId, eic.name, eic.sort_no, eic.weight FROM eval_index_category eic WHERE eic.system_id = #{systemId} AND eic.deleted = 0

SELECT eii.item_id AS itemId, eii.category_id AS categoryId, eii.name, eii.threshold, eii.weight,
sit.name AS indexTypeName, scw.name AS calcWayName
FROM eval_index_item eii
LEFT JOIN sys_index_type sit ON eii.index_type_id = sit.type_id
LEFT JOIN sys_calc_way scw ON eii.calc_way_id = scw.way_id
WHERE eii.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND eii.deleted = 0
SELECT SUM(weight) FROM eval_index_category WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT SUM(weight) FROM eval_index_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = 0
